units.title: Vector Fields
units.blurb: Picture vector fields, find gradient fields, and measure curl and divergence.

units.title: Line Integrals
units.blurb: Integrate along curves, compute work, and recognize conservative fields.

units.title: Green's Theorem
units.blurb: Turn line integrals around closed curves into double integrals.

units.title: Surfaces and Surface Integrals
units.blurb: Parametrize surfaces and integrate over them, including flux.

units.title: Stokes' and Divergence Theorems
units.blurb: Relate integrals over a region to integrals over its boundary.

units.title: Applications
units.blurb: Use the theorems in physics and engineering.

topics.title: Vector Fields
topics.short: A vector field attaches an arrow to every point.
topics.trouble: Students read the arrows as a path to follow instead of a velocity at each point.

topics.title: Gradient Fields and Potentials
topics.short: F = ∇f for a potential function f.

topics.title: Divergence and Curl
topics.short: ∇ · F measures spreading out; ∇ × F measures rotation.
topics.trouble: Students take the divergence of a scalar function, or think divergence is a vector.

topics.title: What Curl and Divergence Measure
topics.short: Read sources, sinks and spin from a picture of a field.
topics.trouble: Students think any field with curved arrows has nonzero curl.

topics.title: Parametrizing Curves for Integration
topics.short: Write segments, circles and graphs as r(t) with an orientation.
topics.trouble: Students parametrize a segment from B to A when the curve runs from A to B.

topics.title: Line Integrals of Functions
topics.short: ∫_C f ds adds f along a curve, weighted by arc length.
topics.trouble: Students forget the factor |r′(t)| in ds.

topics.title: Line Integrals of Vector Fields
topics.short: ∫_C F · dr measures work along a path.
topics.trouble: Students ignore orientation; reversing the curve changes the sign.

topics.title: Line Integrals in the Form ∫P dx + Q dy
topics.short: Write and compute work with differentials.

topics.title: Circulation and Flux across Plane Curves
topics.short: Flux across a curve uses the outward normal.
topics.trouble: Students use the tangent vector when the flux across a curve needs the normal.

topics.title: The Fundamental Theorem for Line Integrals
topics.short: ∫_C ∇f · dr = f(end) − f(start).
topics.trouble: Students apply the theorem to a field that is not a gradient.

topics.title: Testing for Conservative Fields
topics.short: On a simply connected region, curl F = 0 means F is conservative.
topics.trouble: Students apply the test on a region with a hole, where a curl-free field can still circulate.

topics.title: Finding a Potential Function
topics.short: Integrate one component and match the others.
topics.trouble: Students integrate each component separately and add the results, counting shared terms twice.

topics.title: Path Independence and Closed Loops
topics.short: For conservative fields, work depends only on the endpoints.

topics.title: Green's Theorem: Circulation Form
topics.short: ∮ P dx + Q dy = ∬ (Qx − Py) dA.
topics.trouble: Students go around the boundary clockwise, which flips the sign.

topics.title: Green's Theorem: Flux Form
topics.short: Outward flux equals the integral of the divergence.

topics.title: Area with Green's Theorem
topics.short: Find an area with a line integral, such as ½∮(x dy − y dx).

topics.title: Green's Theorem for Regions with Holes
topics.short: Orient inner boundaries the opposite way.
topics.trouble: Students orient the inner boundary the same way as the outer one.

topics.title: Parametric Surfaces
topics.short: r(u, v) describes a surface with two parameters.

topics.title: Surface Area of a Parametric Surface
topics.short: dS = |r_u × r_v| du dv.

topics.title: Surface Integrals of Functions
topics.short: ∬_S f dS adds f over a surface.
topics.trouble: Students integrate over the shadow region but forget the dS scaling factor.

topics.title: Oriented Surfaces
topics.short: Choose a consistent unit normal, like outward on a closed surface.
topics.trouble: Students let the cross product r_u × r_v decide the direction even when it points inward.

topics.title: Flux Integrals
topics.short: ∬_S F · dS measures flow through a surface.
topics.trouble: Students forget to dot with the normal, or use a unit normal and the scaling factor twice.

topics.title: Stokes' Theorem
topics.short: Circulation around a boundary equals the flux of the curl through the surface.
topics.trouble: Students orient the boundary curve against the surface normal, breaking the right-hand rule.

topics.title: Using Stokes' Theorem to Switch Surfaces
topics.short: Any surface with the same boundary gives the same flux of the curl.

topics.title: The Divergence Theorem
topics.short: Outward flux through a closed surface equals the integral of the divergence inside.
topics.trouble: Students apply it to a surface that is not closed, like a hemisphere without its base.

topics.title: Using the Divergence Theorem
topics.short: Close an open surface or swap a hard flux for an easy volume integral.

topics.title: One Idea, Four Theorems
topics.short: FTC, Green, Stokes and Gauss all relate a region to its boundary.

topics.title: Fluid Flow, Sources and Circulation
topics.short: Interpret flux and curl for moving fluids.

topics.title: Gauss's Law and Electric Flux
topics.short: Flux through a closed surface counts the charge inside.
topics.trouble: Students expect the flux to depend on the surface's shape and size.

topics.title: Maxwell's Equations in Two Forms
topics.short: Move between integral and differential forms using the theorems.

topics.title: Mass and Centers of Mass of Thin Shells
topics.short: Integrate density over a surface.
